_doc: R3 P1-a — DECLARED run expectations (observed once, then declared): the trigger invocation multiset the S1 pay tap fans out to, the declared parked sleepers, and the routed calls that legitimately price nothing. parked: autoAssignOnOrderCreate waits on its reviewed GRACE_PERIOD_MS sleep at LP new (virtual time is not advanced in P1-a). nonPricingCalls: getPublicMenu serves the menu projection (its response carries representation_version, no catalog version id); in P1-a both published versions come from the same source, so the menu epoch cannot change an expectation — differing epochs are S1t-a/b/c (P1-d).
